description: Architecture rules for clean, maintainable code - layering, dependencies, and patterns

rules.description: Controllers should not directly access database
rules.message: Controllers should delegate to services, not access database directly
rules.design_check: Does the design show controllers calling database/repository methods directly? If so, route through a service layer. BLOCK on controller → repository direct calls.

rules.description: Services should not depend on HTTP request objects
rules.message: Services should receive parsed data, not raw request objects
rules.design_check: Does the design show services receiving raw HTTP request objects (req.body, req.params)? If so, controllers should extract data and pass plain objects to services. Flag for correction.

rules.message: Circular dependency detected - refactor to break the cycle
rules.design_check: Does the proposed module/service dependency graph contain any cycles (A depends on B which depends on A)? If so, break the cycle by extracting shared logic into a third module. BLOCK on circular dependencies.

rules.description: Use strategy pattern instead of long switch statements
rules.message: Long switch statement - consider strategy pattern
rules.design_check: Does the design have multiple variants of behavior handled by a single large conditional? Consider proposing a strategy pattern with a map of handlers. Flag for review.
Do all proposed API endpoints include a version prefix (e.g., /api/v1/)? Flag any endpoint without versioning.

rules.description: Use lookup tables instead of database ENUMs
rules.message: Use lookup tables instead of ENUMs for flexibility
rules.design_check: Does the design propose ENUM types in the database schema? Replace with lkp_* lookup tables. BLOCK.

rules.description: Consider soft delete for important data
rules.message: Consider using soft delete (is_deleted flag) for audit purposes
rules.design_check: Does the design include hard-delete operations for important business entities (users, orders, vehicles)? Recommend adding a deleted_at or is_deleted column for soft deletes and audit purposes.

rules.message: Consider using async/await for better readability
Nested transactions increase complexity and failure modes
rules.design_check: Does the design show nested or overlapping transaction boundaries (a service starting a transaction inside another transaction)? If so, flatten the transaction scope. BLOCK.

rules.description: Domain logic must not read environment variables
rules.message: Environment access belongs to infrastructure layer
rules.design_check: Does the design show domain/entity classes reading environment variables (process.env, os.environ)? Move env access to config/infrastructure layer and inject values via constructor. BLOCK.

rules.description: Frontend components must not hardcode reference/lookup data as static arrays
rules.message: Hardcoded reference data (status codes, contact types, address types, etc.) must be fetched from a backend lookup API and cached client-side. Only derived UI concerns (colors, icons, CSS classes keyed by code) may remain as frontend constants.
rules.design_check: Does any proposed component define a static array of reference/lookup data (e.g. status options, contact types, address types, priority levels)? If the data originates from a database table, it must be fetched via a backend API and cached client-side — not hardcoded. Flag for correction.
